blocks.text: JERUSALEM, Israel—Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel’s consummate political survivor, is facing the fight of his life in Tuesday’s elections. He is drawing on over three decades of experience to convince voters he is still the only candidate capable of keeping them safe.
